text: The description of greasy yellow scales on the scalp and forehead in a 3-month-old is classic for seborrheic dermatitis, commonly known as cradle cap. To confirm the diagnosis and rule out atopic dermatitis, I need to know if the rash is itchy and if there are any lesions in flexural areas like the elbows or knees.
